newsitem.title: JAPAN: Recent forex moves show G7 pact filtered thru -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Recent forex moves show G7 pact filtered thru -- MOF.

text.p: Recent developments in currency markets have shown that an agreement by the Group of Seven (G7) industrialised nations in late April has fully filtered through the markets, Vice Finance Minister Tadashi Ogawa told a news conference on Thursday.
Asked if the recent appreciation of the yen against the dollar is desirable or too rapid, Ogawa said he would like to refrain from making comments about specific currency moves.
"However, we take it that the recent currency moves show that the contents of the G7 agreement have fully filtered through the currency market."
He said Japan will keep close watch on currency developments and will continue to take appropriate and timely measures as needed.
The G7 nations issued a statement on April 27 saying that deviation of exchange rates from economic fundamentals is undesirable.
